{{Hatnote|1=This is a subarticle of [[Squadron Members]].}}
'''Shadow Squadron''' was the [[Players Committee]] volunteer squadron for SWCCG, YJCCG, and JKTCG.<ref name="vol2003">[https://web.archive.org/web/20030423194826/http://www.swccgpc.com/volunteers.htm Shadow Squadron], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 23 April 2003)</ref> The volunteers promoted the games, ran demos, supported local conventions, and directed local tournaments.<ref name="vol2003" />

[[Jim Colson]] was Shadow Squadron Leader.<ref name="vol2003" /><ref name="council2002">[https://web.archive.org/web/20021209221742/http://www.swccgpc.com/council.htm Advocate Council], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 9 December 2002)</ref><ref name="council2004">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040603222905/http://www.swccgpc.com/council.htm Advocate Council], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 3 June 2004)</ref><ref name="council2005">[https://web.archive.org/web/20050829220138/http://www.swccgpc.com/council.htm Advocate Council], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 29 August 2005)</ref> The rosters used here were captured on 23 April 2003, 4 June 2004, and 3 December 2005.<ref name="vol2003" /><ref name="vol2004">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040604020531/http://www.swccgpc.com/volunteers.htm Shadow Squadron], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 4 June 2004)</ref><ref name="vol2005">[https://web.archive.org/web/20051203064943/http://www.swccgpc.com/volunteers.htm Shadow Squadron], swccgpc.com (Wayback, 3 December 2005)</ref>

== Members ==

Every name printed on the 23 April 2003, 4 June 2004, or 3 December 2005 Shadow Squadron pages is in one table, [[Jim Colson]] first, then by designation number.<ref name="vol2003" /><ref name="vol2004" /><ref name="vol2005" /> A person who is absent from a later roster stays in the table; Notes records the last capture that names them. [[Geert Verhamme]] is printed with no designation.<ref name="vol2004" /> The 3 December 2005 page prints Shadow 70 for both [[Greg Otte]] and [[Jeff Stombaugh]].<ref name="vol2005" /> Hoth: Ice Plains, Chandrila, Ithor, Mon Calamari, and Ord Mantell are printed with no members on that page.<ref name="vol2005" />

== Earlier rosters ==

The 23 April 2003 page is one table, not sorted by region.<ref name="vol2003" /> It names [[Jim Colson]] as Shadow Squadron Leader above the table and gives him no row.<ref name="vol2003" /> That table has 48 designations plus [[Geert Verhamme]] (Uden, Netherlands), whose designation cell is blank.<ref name="vol2003" />

The 4 June 2004 page sorts members by region.<ref name="vol2004" /> It lists [[Jim Colson]] as Shadow Leader in Huntsville, Alabama, and as Dagobah Flight Leader.<ref name="vol2004" /> [[Josh Radke]] is Shadow 4 in Bristol, Connecticut, and Kashyyyk Flight Leader on that page only.<ref name="vol2004" /> Hoth: Ice Plains has a Montreal, Quebec, Canada row with no name and no designation.<ref name="vol2004" /> [[Geert Verhamme]] is still at Uden, with no designation.<ref name="vol2004" />

[[Peter Jacobson]] is in Rochester, Minnesota, on 23 April 2003 and in Owatonna, Minnesota, on 4 June 2004 and 3 December 2005.<ref name="vol2003" /><ref name="vol2004" /><ref name="vol2005" /> [[Benoit Morel]] is in Paris on the 2003 and 2004 pages and in Orleans on the 2005 page.<ref name="vol2003" /><ref name="vol2004" /><ref name="vol2005" />

[[David Morello]] is Shadow 32 on 23 April 2003 and Shadow 34 on the later two pages.<ref name="vol2003" /><ref name="vol2004" /><ref name="vol2005" /> [[Jeff Hansen]] is Shadow 86, then Shadow 5, then Shadow 05, with no city on any of the three pages.<ref name="vol2003" /><ref name="vol2004" /><ref name="vol2005" /> [[Chris Hines]] is Shadow 8 on the 2003 and 2004 pages and Shadow 08 on the 2005 page.<ref name="vol2003" /><ref name="vol2004" /><ref name="vol2005" /> [[Mauricio Sanchez]] is Shadow 9 on the 2003 and 2004 pages and Shadow 09 on the 2005 page.<ref name="vol2003" /><ref name="vol2004" /><ref name="vol2005" />

Names on the 3 December 2005 table who are absent from the 23 April 2003 table are [[Steve Sanders|Stephen Sanders]], [[Jason Huffman]], [[Steve Florent]], [[Greg Otte]], [[Joe Radi]], [[Adam Matteson]], [[Greg Zinn]], [[Ray Bordier]], [[Chris Schwartz]], [[Mike Sugden]], [[Steven Vallee]], [[Scott Vales]], [[Randy Cross]], [[Tim Guzman]], [[Scott Church]], [[Michael Wages]], [[David Evans]], [[Brandon Ruck]], [[Royce Russell]], [[Jim Sharp]], [[Jacob Taylor]], [[Paul Schumacher]], [[Angelo Consoli]], [[Dennis Hes]], [[Wojciech Wisniewski]], [[Tania De Pauw]], [[Stefaan Lambrecht]], [[Thomas Caspersen|Thomas Casperson]].<ref name="vol2003" /><ref name="vol2005" /> [[Jim Colson]] is the leader named above the 2003 table, and a row on the 2004 and 2005 pages.<ref name="vol2003" /><ref name="vol2004" /><ref name="vol2005" />
